methodology: Identified parser-corrupted genus entries where AHS PDF page break / column wrap truncated genus name and family name. Verified via beckett-clean.txt cross-reference and Wikidata Q-code lookups.
legitimateLookingSuspect: These 63 genera have broken/truncated family names but are otherwise real plant genera — covered by task #44 (re-parse AHS species descriptions)

AITON.reason: AHS PDF parsing artifact: genus name AITONIA was truncated to AITON, family MELIACEAE truncated to ELIACEAE. Original Thunberg Aitonia capensis renamed to Nymania capensis by Lindberg.
AITON.wrongLtNameAttribution: inat 51886 = Urtica (Dilgėlė, nettle) — random nearest match

BLECH.reason: AHS PDF parsing artifact: BLECHNUM truncated to BLECH, family fragment NACEAE remains (from BLECHNACEAE).

CAPRI.reason: AHS PDF parsing artifact: CAPRIFOLIUM truncated to CAPRI, family fragment FOLIACEAE remains (from CAPRIFOLIACEAE).
CAPRI.wrongLtNameAttribution: inat 51874 = Lonicera (Sausmedis) — accidentally semi-correct, but mapping was a coincidence

DARWIN.reason: AHS PDF parsing artifact: DARWINIA truncated to DARWIN. Species Darwin citriodora should be Darwinia citriodora.
DARWIN.wrongLtNameAttribution: wikidata Q268013 (Charles Darwin disambiguation page) — wrong

ELANTH.reason: AHS PDF parsing artifact: ELANTH not a real genus; could be fragment of multiple genera (HELIANTHUS, DIANTHUS, etc.) — species Elanth tenax suggests PHORMIUM tenax (Phormiaceae).

FERAE.reason: AHS PDF parsing artifact: FERULA truncated to FERAE, family UMBELLIFERAE truncated to ACEAE. Species Ferae archangelica = Angelica archangelica.

HAMAM.reason: AHS PDF parsing artifact: HAMAMELIS truncated to HAMAM, family HAMAMELIDACEAE truncated to ELIDACEAE.

HEIVI.reason: AHS PDF parsing artifact: HEIVI not a real genus; species Heivi cookianum/colensoi/tenax map to PHORMIUM (Phormiaceae). Family fragment EROCALLIDACEAE = HEMEROCALLIDACEAE truncation.

HYACI.reason: AHS PDF parsing artifact: HYACINTHUS truncated to HYACI, family HYACINTHACEAE truncated to NTHACEAE.

IXIOLI.reason: AHS PDF parsing artifact: IXIOLIRION truncated to IXIOLI, family fragment RIACEAE remains.

PLANTAGI.reason: AHS PDF parsing artifact: PLANTAGO truncated to PLANTAGI, family PLANTAGINACEAE truncated to NACEAE.

RITA.reason: AHS PDF parsing artifact: CHIRITA truncated to RITA. Beckett confirms Chirita lavandulacea + Chirita sinensis exist.
RITA.wrongLtNameAttribution: wikidata Q194437 = Hindu Rta religious concept — non-plant

SCROPH.reason: AHS PDF parsing artifact: SCROPHULARIA truncated to SCROPH, family fragment PLANTACINACEAE = corrupted PLANTAGINACEAE/SCROPHULARIACEAE merge.

VALIA.reason: AHS PDF parsing artifact: DUVALIA truncated to VALIA. Duvalia corderoyi is a real succulent species.
VALIA.wrongLtNameAttribution: wikidata Q364340 = philosophical will concept — non-plant

notes: curated-300.json was checked for artifact contamination — 0 matches found, no impact.
These 14 artifacts polluted lt-names.json by matching to wrong Wikidata Q-codes (people/concepts) or random iNat taxonIds.
After deletion, future AHS re-parse (task #44) should restore real CHIRITA/DARWINIA/DUVALIA/HYACINTHUS/PLANTAGO/SCROPHULARIA/etc. entries cleanly.
